title: Advertising Specialist
description:
Job Description
The Advertising Specialist plays a critical role in executing and optimizing advertising strategies for brands across major marketplaces like Amazon, Noon, and Target. This role supports Advertising Strategists by managing day-to-day tasks, maintaining strong communication, and ensuring operational excellence across campaigns. The Advertising Specialist contributes to both the technical execution and support of advertising initiatives to drive performance and client satisfaction.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Partner closely with Advertising Strategists and cross-functional teams to support the development and execution of advertising.
Manage and monitor advertising campaign tasks using internal project management tools.
Own or co-own portions of the advertising workflow including keyword research, campaign builds, and performance monitoring across Amazon, Walmart, and Target.
Proactively coordinate between the Campaigns and Keywords teams and the Special Projects team, ensuring alignment and timely execution of tasks.
Build performance reports to support strategic decisions and client updates.
Contribute to the development of performance reports to aid strategic decisions and client updates.
Lead or assist with the execution of technical advertising projects.
Maintain a deep understanding of marketplace-specific advertising best practices and business operations.
Communicate proactively with strategists to provide updates, flag risks, and ensure smooth project closures.
Leverage internal software and tools to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and timely delivery of advertising tasks.
Collaborate with and support premium and complex brands across various product categories.
Qualifications
6+ months of hands-on experience in pay-per-click (PPC) advertising, preferably within Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, similar e-commerce platforms, or Google Ads.
Proven experience with campaign building, including keyword research, ad group structuring, and targeting setup.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret advertising performance data and create clear, actionable reports.
Familiarity with internal reporting tools, Excel/Google Sheets, and ad platforms' native dashboards.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Excellent communication skills and comfort working closely with cross-functional teams across time zones.
Self-starter with strong attention to detail and a desire to grow in the digital advertising space.
Required Skills and Abilities
Interpersonal Skills: Self-motivated, team player, builds trust, action and results-oriented; open and collaborative style; must be comfortable working in an environment where ideas are shared and challenged.
Communication Skills: Strong, professional written, oral, interpersonal and presentation skills and the ability to effectively interface with all ranges of employees and customers.
Attention to Detail: Thoroughness in accomplishing tasks, double-checking the accuracy and quality of own work to provide precise and consistent outputs.
Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to operate as both an effective tactical and strategic thinker; excellent and creative problem-solving skills, including negotiation and conflict resolution; able to apply independent judgment and provide insightful analysis in a team setting.
This role is for India general shift.
Our Core Values
Data Fanatics: Our edge is always found in the data
Partner Obsessed: We are obsessed with partner success
Team of Doers: We have a bias for action
Gamechangers: We encourage innovation
Why Pattern?
The company is a rocket ship experiencing phenomenal growth
We have tailwinds and a long runway; we’re barely scratching the surface
We have big opportunities that will get you energized and excited
Equity and competitive salary

What is a day in the life of a Finance Director?
Own the full FP&A cycle across Asia and Australia, from annual operating plan through monthly close, forecast, and variance analysis
Business Partnering: Serve as the primary financial thought partner to the Managing Directors of Asia and Australia and their leadership teams on key business decisions
Strategic Planning: Build and maintain long-range financial models that inform regional expansion, investment prioritization, and resource allocation
Forecasting: Develop rolling forecasts that integrate financial and operational KPIs, with enough granularity to drive action at the region and brand level
Reporting: Design and deliver reporting that gives leadership a clear, current view of performance vs. plan, and tells them what to do about it
Decision Support: Lead high-impact financial projects that cut across functions and geographies, delivering the analysis and recommendations that drive the region's most consequential business decisions

What will I need to thrive in this role?
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; CPA, CFA, or MBA a plus
8-15 years of progressive Finance experience in complex, matrixed, or multinational businesses
Proven ability to lead with influence rather than headcount (expected team size of ~2-3 people)
Commercially sharp communicator who can align stakeholders across cultures, functions, and time zones
High tolerance for ambiguity; thrives in fast-moving environments where structure, process, and playbooks are still being built
Hands-on operator with a bias for detail – willing to build the model and present it to leadership
Deep FP&A skills across budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning, grounded in solid accounting fundamentals
Fluent in data – experienced turning large, complex datasets into scalable reporting and decision-support tools
Native AI user – integrates AI meaningfully into daily workflows and project delivery, not just as a novelty
Proficient in cloud-based Finance platforms (Netsuite, Workday Adaptive, etc.); Excel super-user
Mandarin and English fluency (written and spoken)
eCommerce, Retail, or large global organization experience strongly preferred

What is the team like?
You will partner with the Managing Directors of Asia and Australia and work with functional leaders in all areas of the business. You will report to the VP of International Finance Operations in the US and lead other Finance and Accounting team members across APAC. The team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement and drive actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.
This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to C-suite leadership and the chance to help shape how a publicly traded company scales internationally.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?
We are looking for individuals who are:
Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed
Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics

2. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES & IMPACT AREAS (THE "WHAT")
A. High-Converting Copywriting & Design Alignment
Collaborative Design-Copy Integration: Partner with Art Directors to draft, iterate, and integrate conversion-centric copy within established visual templates for Amazon listings.
Brand Voice Tailoring: Adapt writing style, tone, and messaging dynamically to reflect the distinct guidelines and target audiences of highly diverse partner brands.
Listing Optimization: Ensure all copy is technically aligned with Amazon’s guidelines, metadata constraints, and A+ content best practices.
B. Performance Optimization & SEO
Data-Driven Iteration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather market performance insights and refine copy based on behavioral metrics and search performance.
SEO Execution: Apply rigorous search engine optimization principles to maximize natural keyword indexing and listing discoverability.
C. Creative Operations, Quality Assurance & Reporting
Project Health Management: Generate and maintain progress reports detailing project timelines, status updates, task health, and milestone updates.
Quality Control & Compliance: Maintain absolute accuracy, grammar, and brand compliance across all deliverables under tight, fast-paced deadlines.
Leadership & Team Alignment: Actively participate in biweekly QA, copy, and PM alignment sessions, and contribute monthly updates to the Director of Creative Project Management.
3. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) (THE "HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED")
On-Time Delivery: Maintain a $\ge 95\%$ on-time completion rate for copywriting milestones under strict campaign schedules.
Quality Assurance Rating: Minimize copy-related QA loops to an average of fewer than 1.5 iterations per asset.
SEO Performance: Improve or sustain keyword indexing and search visibility rankings for optimized listings.
Listing Conversion Lift: Demonstrate measurable improvements in listing conversion rates (CVR) and click-through rates (CTR) post-copy optimization.
4. PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT & CAREER PATHWAYS
This position is structured to support rapid career growth into senior copywriting, strategic content engineering, or management roles. Pattern is committed to developing your skills in:
Strategic Campaign Framing: Shifting from basic tactical execution to viewing projects through a long-term commercial and brand-equity lens.
Industry & Market Analysis: Building high-level expertise in market dynamics, competitive positioning, and consumer psychology.
Personnel & Creative Management: Cultivating leadership competencies, mentoring junior talent, and driving operational creative processes.
5. TECHNICAL & STRATEGIC COMPETENCIES

Experience : 2 to 3 years
B2C Copywriting: Proven experience crafting persuasive, conversion-oriented copy (preferably for Amazon or equivalent e-commerce ecosystems).
SEO Foundations: Robust understanding of SEO principles, organic search optimization, and keyword integration.
Communication Mastery: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an acute eye for grammatical precision.
Strategic Flexibility: Ability to pivot tone and style seamlessly across diverse consumer verticals (e.g., consumer tech, FMCG, outdoor gear).
Tools & Operations: Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, and project tracking tools, Chat GPT, Claude.
Collaboration: A demonstrated ability to thrive in highly collaborative, cross-functional settings.
AI Proficiency: Awareness, willingness, and a basic understanding of using AI tools in copywriting and content creation workflows.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with the U.S.-based team and work successfully in a global, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
In-depth familiarity with Amazon’s compliance rules, listing structures, and retail media ecosystem.
